verdict.rationale: The README documents a model picker that lets you choose a model and effort level per chat from your account's catalog. It also says you can add your own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys, which covers choosing the model from multiple providers. missing for 10: an explicit list of supported providers beyond OpenAI/Anthropic, confirmation that BYO-key models appear in the per-session picker, independent or hands-on corroboration.
